label: Mimosa C5x IP67 Radio (100-00101)
description: Mimosa C5x IP67 modular radio, 700 Mbps IP (866 PHY), takes N5-X antennas. 1x 1G RJ45 with passive PoE-in (24-56 V).
notes: The **IP67 variant of the C5x** (SKU 100-00101), same ports and radio as `mimosa/c5x`: **1 x gigabit Ethernet, passive PoE 24-56 V, 700 Mbps IP (866 PHY)**.
